title: #45. Fath e Makkah Part 3
arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمةُ الله وَبَرَكَاتُه’

In Sha Allah O Ta'ala (اِنْ شاءالله تعالى).

اَمَرَبِلَالً اَنْ يُؤَذَنَ لِيَغِيْظَ بِهِ الْمُشْرِكِيْنْ فَلَمَّا كَانَ لَيْلَةْ دَخَلَ النَّاسِ مَكَّه، لَيْلَةَ الْفَتْحْ لَمْ يَزالُ فِيْ تَكْبِيْرٍ، وَ فِيْ تَهْلِيْلٍ ، وَ فِيْ طَوَافٍ بِالْبَيْتْ حَتَّى اَصْبَح

فَقَالَ اَبُوْ سٌفِيَّانْ لِهِنْدْ اَتَرَيْنَ هَذَا مِنَّ الله ، قَالَ : نَعْمْ ، هَذا مِنَّ الله لَا اِلَهَ اِلَّا الله اَتَرَيْنَ هَذَا مِنَّ الله

إنَّ الله حَرَّمَ مَكَّةَ يَومَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضَ فَهِيَّ حَرَامٌ بِحَرَمَ اللَّهِ إلى يَومُ الْقِيَامَةِ، لَا تَحِلُّ لِأحَدٍ قَبْلِي

وَلَا تَحِلُّ لِاَحَدٍ بَعْدِيْ ، وَلَمْ تَحْلُلْ لِيْ إلَّا سَاعَةً مِنَّ الدَّهَر لَا يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهَا، وَلَا يُعْضَدُ شَوْكُهَا، ولَا يُخْتَلَى خَلَاهَا، ولَا تَحِلُّ لُقَطَتُهَا، إلَّا لِمُنْشِطْ

فَكَانَ يَصْنَعُ بْعْضُنَا لِبَعْضِ الطَّعَامْ مِمَّا يُكْثِرْ اَنْ يَدْعُوْنَا الى رَحْلِهْ فَقُلْتُ اَلَا اَصْنَعَ طَعَامً فَاَدْعُوْهُمْ اِلَى رَحْلِيْ

فَاَمِرْتُ بِطَعَامٍ يَصْنَعْ، ثُمَّ لَقِيْتُ اَبَا هُرَيْرَةْ اَلدَّعْوَةْ عِنْدِيْ اَلْلَيْلَةْ اَسْبَقْتَنِيْ اَلَا اعْلِمَكُمْ بِحَدِيْثٍ مِنْ حَدِيْثِكُمْ، يَا مَعْشَرِالْاَنْصَارْ؟

ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ فَتَحْ مَكَّةْ فَقَالْ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُوْل الله قُرَيْشْ وَبَشَتَ لَهَا اَوْبَاشًا اَتَرَوْنَ اِلَى اَوْبَاشٍ قُرَيْش وَاَتْبَاعِهِمْ؟ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِيَدَيْهِ اِحَدَاهُمَا عَلَى اُخْرَى، ثُمَّ قَالَ حَتَّى تُوَافُوْنِيْ بِالصَّفَا

مَنْ دَخَلَ دَارْ اَبِيْ سُفِيَان فَهُوَ آمِنْ وَمَنْ دَخَلَ مَنْزِلَه’ فَهُوَ آمِنْ أقُلْتُمْ اَمَّا رَجُلْ فَاَدْكْتُه’ رَغْبَةَ فِيْ قَرْيَتِه ، قَالُوْ قَدْكَانَ ذَالِكْ

اِنِّيْ عَبْدُالله وَرَسُوْلُه هَاجَرْتُ اِلَى الله وَاِلَيْكُمْ فَالْمَحْيَا مَحْيَاكُمْ وَالْمَمَاتُ مَمَاتُكُمْ فَاَقْبَلُوا الَيْه يَبْكُوْنَ

وَلله مَا قُلْنَا اَلَّذِيْ قُلْنَا اِلَّا الظنْ بِالله وَرَسُوْلِه اِنَّ الله وَرَسُوْلَه يَصَدِّقَانِكُمْ فَدَعَاهُمْ اِلَى الْاِسْلَامْ فَلَمْ يُحْسِنُو اَنْ يَقُوْلُوْ اَسْلَمْنَا

صَبَاعْنَا وَلله لَا اَقْتُلْ اَسِيْرِيْ ،وَلَا يَقْتُلْ رَجُلٌ مِنْ اَصْحَابِي اَسِيْرًا اَللَّهُمَ اِنِيْ اَبْرَاءُ اِلَيْكَ مِمَّا صَنْعَ خَالِدْ اَللَّهُمَ اِنِيْ اَبْرَاءُ اِلَيْكَ مِمَّا صَنْعَ خَالِدْ

اَسْلمِيْ حُبَيْشْ ، قَبْلَنَا نَفَادَ الْعَيْشْ قَبْلَنَا نَفَادَ الْعَيْشْ فَدَيْتُكَ اَمَا كَانَ فِيْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَحِيْمْ فَقَتَلَ طَائِفَةْ كَثِيْرَةْ مِنْهُمْ، وَقَتَلَ اَكْثَرَ الْاَسرَى اَيْضاً

فقتلا, وَمَعَ هَذَا لَمْ يَعْزِلَه’ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بَلِّ اسْتَمَرَّ بِهِ اَمِيْرًا وَاِنْ كَانَ تَبرا مِنْه’ فِيْ صَنْيِعْهِ ذَالِكْ

وَوَدَى مَا كَانَ جَنَاه’ خَطَاً فِيْ دَمِّ اَوْ مَالٍ فَفِيْهِ دَلِيْلٌ لَاَحَدٍ الْقَوْلَيْنِ بَيْنَ الْعَلَمَاءْ فِيْ اَنَّ خَطَاَ الْاِمَامْ يَكُوْن فِيْ بَيْتِ الْمَال’

وَلِهَذا لَمْ يَعْزِلْه’ اَلصَدِّيق حِيْنَ قَتَلَ مَالِك بِنْ نُوْيْرَةْ اَيَّامً الرِّدَّةْ، وَتَاَّوَل عَلَيْهِ مَا تَاَّوَّلَ حِيْنَ ضَرَبَ عُنُقَه’ وَاصْطَفى اِمْرَاَتَه’ اُمُ تَمِيْمْ

اِعْزِلْه’ فَاِنَّ فِيْ سَيْفِه رَهَقاً فَقَالَ اَلصِدِيِقْ لَا اَغْمِدُ سَيْفَاً سَلَّهُ الله عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ اَلْمُسْلِمْ أَخُ الْمُسْلِمْ، لَا يَظْلِمُه، وَلَا يَخْذِلُه’، وَلَا يَكْذِبُه’، ولا يحقره،

تَلَوَّنَ وَجْهَ رَسول الله صلى الله علي وسلم وَقَالَ: اَتُكَلِّمُنِيْ فِيْ حَدٍ مِنْ حَدُوْدِ الله إستغفرلي يا رسول الله فَاِنَّمَا اَهْلَكَ النَّاس قَبْلِكُم اَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْ اِذَا سَرَقَ فِيْهِمْ الشَّرِيْف تَرَكُوْا

وَاِذَا سَرَقَ فِيْهِمْ اَلضَّعِيْفْ اَقَامُوا عَلَيْهَ الْحَدْ وَالَّذِى نَفْسٌ محمد بِيَدِه لَوْ اَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْت محمد سَرَقَتْ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا

ثُمَّ اَمَرَ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتِلْكَ الْمَرَاَةَ فَقُطِعَتْ يَدُهَا فَحَسُنَتْ تَوْبَتُهَا فَكَانَتْ تَاْتِيْ بَعْدَ ذَالِكَ فَاَرْفَعَ حَاجَتَهَا اِلَى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

مَسْتَقَامَتْ عَلَيْهَا اَمَّتُكُمْ لَا هِجْرَةَ  وَلَكِنْ جِهَادْ وَنِيَّةْ لَا هِجْرَةَ  وَلَكِنْ جِهَادْ وَنِيَّةْ وَاِذَا اسْتُنْفِرْتُمْ فَانْفِرُوْا

اُبَايِعُه’ عَلى الاِسْلام والْجِهَادْ لَا هِجْرَةَ الْيَوْم، كَانَ الْمُؤمِنُ يَفِرُّ اَحَدَهُمْ بِدِيْنِهِ اِلَى الله ، عَزُّوجَل، وَاِلَى رَسُوْلِه صلى الله عليه وسلم

مَخَافَةَ اَنْ يُفْتَنَ عَلَيْهِ فَاَمَا الْيَوْم فَقَدْ اَظْهَرَ الله الْاِسْلَامَ ، فَاْلْمُؤمِنُ يَعْبُدُ رَبَّه’ حَيْثُ يَشَاءْ ، وَلَكِنْ جِهَادٌ وَنِيَّةْ

فَاَمَّا الْيَوْم فَلَمْ تَبْقَ الْهِجْرَةْ، الَّلهُمَّ اِلَّا اَنْ يَعْرَضَ حَالٌ يَقْتَضِي الْهِجْرَةَ بِسَبَبْ مُجَاوَرَةِ اَهْلَ الْحَرْبِ ، وَعَدَمَ الْقُدْرَةَ عَلَى اِظْهَارِ الدِّيْنِ عِنْدَهُمْ ،

فَتَجِبُ الْهِجْرَةَ اِلَى دَارِ الْاِسْلَام، وَهَذَا مِمَّا لَا خِلَافَ عليْهِ بَيْنَ الْعُلَمَاءْ وَكَانَ يَمُرُّ بِنَا الرُكْبَانْ فَنَسْاَلُهُمْ: مَا لِلنَّاسِ مَاِللنَّاسِ؟ مَا هَذَاالرَّجُلْ؟

فَيَقُوْلُوْنْ: يَزْعَمُ اَنَّ الله اَرْسَلَه’ وَاَوْحَى اِلَيْهِ أو أوحى الله بِكَذَا فَكُنْتُ اَحْفَظْ ذَالِكَ الْكَلَامْ فَكَاَنَّمَا يَقر فِي صَدْرِيْ

وَكَانَتِ الْعَرَبْ تَلَوَمُ بِاِسْلَامِهِمْ الْفَتْحْ، وَكَانَتِ الْعَرَبْ تَلَوَمُ بِاِسْلَامِهِمْ الْفَتْحْ، فَيَقُوْلُوْنْ: اَتْرَكُوْه’ وَقَوْمَه’، فَاِنَّه’ اِنْ ظَهَرَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَهُوَ نَبِيٌ صَادِقْ

إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۚ بَادَرَ كُلَّ قَوْمٍ بِاِسْلَامِهِمْ وَبَدَرَ اَبِيْ قَوْمِيْ بِاِسْلَامِهِمْ

فَلَمَّا قَدَمْ جِئْتُكُمْ وَاللهِ مِنْ عِنْدَ نَّبِيْ حَقًا حقًا فَقَالْ صَلُّوْ صَلَاةَ كَذَافِيْ حِيْنَ كَذَا وَصَلُوْ صَلَاةَ كَذَا فِيْ حِيْنَ كَذَا ،

فَاِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةْ فَلْيُؤَذِّنْ اَحَدكُمْ، وَلَيؤُمَّكُمْ اَكْثَرَكُمْ قُرْآنَا فَنَظَرُوْ افَلَمْ يَكُنْ اَحَدٌ اَكْثَرْ قُرْآنًا مِّنِّي

لِمَا كُنْتُ اَتَلَقَّى مِنَّ الرُّكْبَاْن فَقَدَّمُوْنِيْ بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَاَنَا ابْنُ سِتٍ اَوْ سَبْعِ سِنِيْنَ، وَكَانَتْ عَلَيَّ بُرْدَةٌ اِذَا سَجَدْتَ تَقَلَّصَتْ عَنِّيْ

وَكُنْتُ اِذَا سَجَدْتَ تَقَلَّصَتْ عَنِّيْ فَقَالَتِ امْرَاَةْ مِنَ الْحَيّْ اَلَا تُغَطُّوْنَ عَنَّا اسْتَ قارِئِكُمْ فَكُنْتُ اَؤمَّهُمْ فِيْ بَرْدَةْ مَوْصُوْلَة فيفتق فَكُنْتُ اِذَا سَجَدْتْ خَرَجَتْ إستيْ

فَقَطَعُوْا لِيْ قَمِيْصًا، فَمَا فَرِحْتُ بِشَيْءٍ فَرَحِيْ بِذَالِكَ الْقَمِيْصْ صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًاكَثِيْرَا
english:
The Life Of Muhammadﷺ, Madinan Period, Volume 2 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, We're finishing with some miscellaneous events concerning Fath e Makkah(فتح مكه),

Rasool Allah ﷺ, when he entered into Makkah he chose a Mo'azzin(مؤذن), someone to call the Adhan(آذان).

And the particular choice of Rasool Allah ﷺ was Bilal Ibn Rabah رضي الله عنه.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ had Bilal(بلال) climb over Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) to deliver the Adhan(آذان).

According to Younas Bin Mukhair(يونس بن مخير), Rasool Allah ﷺ ordered Rasool Allah ﷺ ordered Bilal(بلال) to give Adhan(آذان) in order to anger the polytheists.

Because Bilal(بلال) was seen as a slave, and now he's calling to the Salah(صلاة), and he's climbing over Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) to do it.

And therefore there were some narrations of comments made by the people of Makkah showing their displeasure with the fact that Bilal(بلال) was the one, who is calling the Adhan(آذان),

like one of them said; Can you see this black crow barking from on top of Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) and things like that derogatory terms made by the Mushrikeen(مشركين) of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Rasool Allah ﷺ, intended to have Bilal(بلال) make the Adhan(آذان) to show them just what we were talking about before, the new era that Islam is bringing,

where class and caste of Jahilliyah(جاهلية) do not matter anymore and it is Taqwa(تقوى) that makes a person high or low.

It is according to how close they are to Allahعَزّوجَلّ, it is their Taqwa(تقوى) it is their following of Islam.

And according to Saeed Bin Musayyib رحمه الله, that particular day when the people entered into Makkah it wasn't a day of celebration, it wasn't a day of partying.

It says; When the people entered into Makkah, the day of conquest, they remained in Takbeer(تكبير) and Tahleel(تحليل).

Tahleel(تحليل) meaning saying; And Takbeer(تكبير) means saying Allah-Ho-Akbar(الله اكبر) and Tawaf Bil Bait(طواف بِالْبَيت) circling Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

They've been away from Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه) for a long time.

And now they are pleased and happy that Allahعَزّوجَلّ allowed them to enter into Makkah and to worship Allah according to the rules of Islam, while Islam is dominant in Makkah.

So, they were making Tawaf(طواف) around the house all the way until, the morning there was Ibadah(عبادة), all night all night long, there was Ibadah(عبادة).

Wherever you go in Makkah you can see people making Takbeer(تكبير) and making Tahleel(تحليل) and making Tawaf(طواف) around the house of Allah.

So, Abu Sufiyan(أبوسُفيان) went back to his wife and said; Do you think this is from Allah?

I mean, it's an impressive scene, it's something that even affected these people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) people of Makkah, who are just moments ago Kuffar(كفار).

So Abu Sufiyan(أبوسُفيان) told his wife: Do you think this is from Allah?

She said: Yes, this is from Allah.

And then Abu Sufiyan(أبوسُفيان) met Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; You told Hind(هند): Do you think this is from Allah?

And Hind told you: Yes, I think this is from Allah.

Abu Sufiyan(أبوسُفيان) said; I testify that you are the Messenger of Allah.

No one overheard our conversation, there was no one there but we, me and Hind(هند).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said as narrated by Al-Bukhari(اَلْبُخَارِيْ); Allah has made Makkah as a sanctuary, the day He created the heavens and the earth

it is the sanctuary by Allah's having made it so, and will remain such until, the Judgment Day.

Conflict in it was not made permissible for anyone before myself, nor for anyone after me.

And this only for a short time.

In it, gain may not be hunted, it's trees may not be cut down, nor mates vegetation be uprooted and items found in it, belong to the Finder only after announcement of the Find.

Al-Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib رضي الله عنه want to exclude from this rule a plant called Al-Izkhar(ألإذخر).

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ said: You're not allowed to cut down trees.

So, Al-Abbas(العباس) wanted to exclude the Al-Izkhar(ألإذخر) .

Because they use it for the dead, it's a fragrant tree, it has a nice smell to it.

And apparently it's also used as fuel for blacksmiths because in another narration says; Lil-Qaim(لِلْقَيْمْ).

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ said except for Al-Izkhar(ألإذخر).

Rasool Allah ﷺ allowed them to cut down this particular plant or a tree but nothing else.

So, Makkah and also Madina are Haram(حرام) and they are a sanctuary, and hunting is not allowed there in and uprooting trees is not allowed.

There's a Hadith(حديث) by Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه, we go through it In Sha Allah(اِنْ شَاالله).

As long as the leaders are following Al-Haqq(اَلْحَقْ), you're going to enjoy the blessings.

And then this woman is a Bedouin, she doesn't have knowledge.

So, she told Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), and who are these Aimmah(آئِمَّه), Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) told her; They are the leaders among you.

So, dear brothers and sisters, we should all make it an objective of ours to try to establish the law of Allahعَزّوجَلّ on Earth.

To try to establish the Islamic system, to try to establish Khilafah(خِلَافَه), this is a responsibility on every Muslim.

We want to live the blessing of the Islamic system.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: After the conquest of Makkah, Before the conquest of Makkah, Hijrah(هجرة) was mandatory it was one of the most important things Muslim should do.

Anybody who becomes Muslim should make Hijrah(هجرة) from Makkah to Madina, or from any other parts of Arabia.

They are in and they should immigrate to Madina.

After Makkah, People would come to Rasool Allah ﷺ and want to make a Hijrah(هجرة), Rasool Allah ﷺ would tell them that there's no more Hijrah(هجرة), Khalas(خلاص).

The Hijrah(هجرة) is over and the people who did it, received the Ajr(أجْر).

It's now too late to do Hijrah(هجرة).

But now, you are replaced with Jihad(جهاد), the thing that takes place of Hijrah(هجرة), and the Ajr(أجْر) of Hijrah(هجرة) is Jihad Fee Sabeel-Lillah(جهاد في سبيل الله).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says in Bukhari(بخاريْ); There is no more Hijrah(هجرة) but Jihad(جهاد) had and intention.

And if you are called to fight then you should respond.

Another man came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and he wanted to give a Baiyah(بَيْعة) to Rasool Allah ﷺ to make Hijrah(هجرة).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: I will take Baiyah(بَيْعة) from him on Islam and Jihad(جهاد) there's no more Hijrah(هجرة).

So, the rule that applies after the conquest of Makkah is Islam and Jihad Fee Sabeel-Lillah(جهاد في سبيل الله).

And Atta Bin Rabah(عطاء بن رباح) one of the Tabieen(تابعين), he said: I visited Ayesha(عائشه) and we asked her about Hijrah(هجرة), she said:

We asked Ayesha(عائشه) about Hijrah(هجرة) she said; There's no more Hijrah(هجرة) now.

The believer used to flee with, his religion to Allah and to the Messenger of Allah because of fear of going through Fitnah(فِتْنَه).

They would fear that they would lose their religion but today, Allahعَزّوجَلّ has made Islam prevalent.

So the believer can worship Allah wherever, he wants, but you should fight Jihad Fee Sabeel-Lillah(جهاد في سبيل الله) and you should have the intentions to do so.

Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) comments on this and says; Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) says; So, there's no more Hijrah(هجرة) except, if there are circumstances that necessitate Hijrah(هجرة),

because of being close to the people of Harb(حرب), the people of war the Kuffar(كفار).

And the inability to show the religion among them, in this situation, Hijrah(هجرة) becomes mandatory to the land of Islam.

And this is something that is agreed upon among the scholars.

So Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) says; There's more no more Hijrah(هجرة), except if we run into a situation that is similar to the situation of the Muslims back then,

then Hijrah(هجرة) would be necessary.

And he gives us the clarification of what he means and that is living among the Kuffar(كفار).

If a person is not able to show his religion if a person can declare his religion publicly, not only the aspects that are individually practiced,

but he can declare all aspects of Islam in this case Hijrah(هجرة) is not mandatory.

But if a person cannot worship Allah as he should then he must make a Hijrah(هجرة) to the land where he can worship Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Nowadays, we do have clear land of Kuffr(كفر) and clear land of Harb(حرب), but we do not have a clear land of Islam.

Therefore, the rule that applies now is that the Muslim should make Hijrah(هجرة) to the place where they can worship Allah the best.

So, it's a relative issue a Muslim, if he is living in a particular place and he is able to worship Allah as he should then he can remain there

but if he's not, then he should search for the place where there's the least fear on his Deen(دِيْن), not his Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) his Deen(دِيْن),

and he should make Hijrah(هجرة) to that place.

The final Hadith(حديث) in this section Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) mentions this Hadith(حديث) as the closing of the chapter of Fath-E-Makkah(فتح مكه).

This Hadith(حديث), it talks about Amr Bin Salamah رضي الله عنه.

Amr Bin Salamah(عَمرُو بن سلمه) was not from Makkah, he belonged to another tribe.

And he describes the situation back then, he says; Whenever the travelers would travel by, we would ask them about this man referring to Muhammadﷺ,

We would ask them, about this man.

So the news about Muhammadﷺ was all over Arabia.

And it was the news of the day.

So, people would ask the travelers about any new news about Muhammadﷺ, that was the major event, the Daw'ah(دعوة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, it was not an obscure Daw'ah(دعوة).

It was the breaking news for the people all over.

So, Amr Bin Salamah(عَمرُو بن سلمه) said; We would ask the travelers about this man, and they would say; So, they would say he claims that Allah has sent him and he's receiving revelation.

And he just received the revelation of this and that.

So these travelers would mentioned some of the Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an, they're up to date.

So, they would mention these Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an, Amr Bin Salamah(عَمرُو بن سلمه) was a child at that time, and he would hear this dialogue, he would hear this conversation

and he would remember those Ayaat(آيات), he would memorize the Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an.

Even though his people were Kuffar(كفار) at that time, but the people were carrying the Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an around even though they were Kuffar(كفار),

but it was the news for them Rasool Ullah receive this, Rasool Allah ﷺ received that.

I used to memorize those words.

As if they would stay inside my breast, these words, the words of Qur'an would just enter into his breast and stay there.

The Arabs were waiting for the conquest, before becoming Muslim.

The Arabs were watching.

They saw two parties in this conflict, Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) on one side and Muhammadﷺ on the other.

And they were waiting to see the result.

That is the situation with many people.

They do not search for the truth, but they look at who is more victorious, they look at who is more victorious and they follow that victorious party.

They were waiting to see who would win.

So, they would say; And they would say: If he wins against his people, they would say: Leave him and his people alone.

If he defeats is people, then he is a Nabi(نَبِي) and he is truthful.

And by the way this is not a correct attitude towards the Daw'ah(دعوة) of the Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء).

But that is what the people used to say; I mean we know from the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, that there are some Ambiyaa(أنبِيَاء), who didn't have any followers, does that make them wrong. No!

I mean, we know the Hadith(حديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, on the day of judgment, there will be a Nabi(نَبِي) with 10, there will be a Nabi(نَبِي) with five,

there will be Nabi(نَبِي) with three, there would be Nabi(نَبِي) with two, there would be a Nabi(نَبِي) with one follower and there would be a Nabi(نَبِي) without any followers all together,

that does not make their Da'wah(دعوة), a failure.

It doesn't mean that they know how to do Da'wah(دعوة), No.

because Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; You do not guide whomever you want, but it is Allah, Who guides.

So, the fact that a Nabi(نَبِي) didn't have any followers, that was the Qadar(قَدَر) of Allah, but he did his job fully in conveying the message.

Anyway, so they waited until Rasool Allah ﷺ defeated his people, Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Now, obviously the ones, who became Muslim earlier, the ones who accepted Islam earlier, they searched for the truth and they found it and they accepted Islam.

Their Ajr(أجْر) and their level in the eyes of Allah is much higher than the ones who became Muslim after the victories of Islam (were becoming very clear),

and that's why it says in Qur'an that the ones who fight Jihad Fee Sabeel-Lillah(جهاد في سبيل الله)  and spend before the conquest, are better and higher in status, than the ones who became Muslim after that, and spent and fought Fee Sabeel-Lillah(في سبيل الله).

So, there's a difference between becoming Muslim before conquest, and the ones who became Muslim after.

Anyway Amr Bin Salamah رضي الله عنه said that when Rasool Allah ﷺ opened Makkah, Every tribe was rushing to become Muslim And my father became Muslim before my people

When he came back, he said; I came to you in the name of Allah from the Nabi ﷺ, He is truly a Prophet of Allah.

he told us, to pray, And he told us to pray this Salah(صلاة) at that time and this Salah(صلاة) at that time.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ gave the father of Amr Bin Salamah(عَمرُو بن سلمه) instructions on how to pray.

So when the time of Salah(صلاة) approaches then one of you should make Adhan(آذَان) and the one, who should be your Imam(اِمَام) is the one who knows the most Qur'an among you.

So, they searched and they found out that no one knew more Qur'an than me.

Because of what I learned from the travelers.

They made me, their Imam(إمام) And I was six years old or seven years old at the time and he became the Imam(اِمَام).

He knew, the most Qur'an among them.

Amr Bin Salamah(عَمرُو بن سلمه) said; He said: I would lead them in Salah(صلاة) and I was wearing a Burdah(بردة), a Burdah(بردة) is a square garment and

When I would make Sujood(سجود), it was too short, this garment that Amr Bin Salamah(عَمرُو بن سلمه) was wearing was too short, so when he would go in Sujood(سجود), what happen is this garment would rise and his behind would show.

So, one woman stood up and said; Wouldn't you, cover from us, the butt of your, O reciter.

So, when she did make that statement that embarrassing statement against Amr Bin Salamah(عَمرُو بن سلمه).

In fact, in another narration, it says; He said: I used to lead them in Salah(صلاة) in a Bardah(بردة), in a Thoub(ثوب) that had a big tear from behind.

So, when I would make Sujood(سجود) my butt would stick out of that, tear and that's why this woman made that statement against him and said,

in front of everyone, this was Ya'ani(يعني) in front of everybody, she said; Cover from us the butt of your, reciter.

So, Amr Bin Salamah(عَمرُو بن سلمه) said; Now, the Imam(اِمَام) said: They bought for me, a Thoub(ثوب), now Subhan Allah(سبحان الله) the Imam(اِمَام) has a new Thoub(ثوب)

he's very happy with it. And this is what he said, he said; And nothing had ever made me so happy as that shirt did.

He was so happy with the new Thoub(ثوب) that, they bought him as an Imam(اِمَام) to cover him up in a Salah(صلاة).

To cover up his Aurah(عَوْرَة).

This is the end of the Ghazwa(غزوة) of Fath Makkah(فتح مكه), by the way this Hadith(حديث) that I just mentioned, is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).
